key_insight: Computing total deformation from particle positions and a fixed reference grid enables fracture-free, perfectly elastic MPM while retaining force evaluation on the current grid.
engineering_relevance: The approach supports large-deformation elastic solid simulation with contact handling compatible with standard MPM frameworks.
method: Compute deformation directly from particle positions and a fixed reference grid, rather than updating it through velocity gradients.
Evaluate elastic forces on the current grid to support grid-based collision handling.
Accommodate particle-level collisions and suppress zero-energy modes associated with nonlinear deformation.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports complex elastic-object simulations with large deformations and contact, but provides no quantitative accuracy or runtime results.
watch_item: Robustness and computational cost of zero-energy mode suppression under extreme deformation require assessment beyond the abstract.
paper_title: Total Deformation-based MPM for Perfectly Elastic Solid Simulation with Strong Deformations
